ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark background with high-contrast white circular rings and irregular mottling. Mottling is most dense along the lower leading edges and tips, while circular ring structures are concentrated in the central and medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated internal pixel angle between 45 and 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense population of high-contrast white circular ring clusters (approx. 10-20 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment scars, primarily located in the central and right-central areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical light-grey linear streaks visible on the left lobe, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular ring scarring (barnacle marks) across the majority of the ventral surface; irregular minor indentation on the far right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense distribution of ring-shaped pixel clusters creating a distinctive 'spotted' or 'ringed' texture across the fluke surface.
